detail.longDescription: I am trying to uncheck the input in a system for 5-star reviews. I want to allow the user to uncheck the input, and therefore uncheck the review, if they click on the same clicked star once again. How can I do this? PS: This IntRange is a type I created myself that treats the numbers within a range, in this case, from 1 to 5. It's written 6 because it takes a number after the maximum, but it should be treated as five. const [rating, setRating] = useState | undefined>(undefined) ... const handlerReview = (e: React.ChangeEvent) => { setRating(Number(e.target.value) as 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5) } const handlerUncheck = (e: React.MouseEvent) => { setRating(prev => prev === Number(e.currentTarget.value) ? undefined : Number(e.currentTarget.value) as 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 ) } ...
